0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-2, 8th in the West and on a two-game winning streak) host the Toronto Raptors (3-3, 7th in the East and on a two-game losing streak) in a matchup where the teams have yet to meet this season. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Toronto is missing Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The Nuggets won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 121-115 home win over Toronto on March 20, 2026.
